messages.author: 79595333c4468c63
messages.subject: problems with 'rat's example: namespace issues
parts:
Hi

I have just installed Stan on my macbook pro (OS X 10.9). I can run the schools example, but get this error with rats:

> print(rats_fit)
Error in .Call("effective_sample_size", sim, n - 1) : 
  "effective_sample_size" not resolved from current namespace (rstan)
> rats_fit
Error in .Call("effective_sample_size", sim, n - 1) : 
  "effective_sample_size" not resolved from current namespace (rstan)

I tried running it again and got this error

> rats_fit <- stan(file = 'rats.stan', data = rats_dat, verbose = TRUE)

TRANSLATING MODEL 'rats' FROM Stan CODE TO C++ CODE NOW.
Error in .Call("CPP_stanc260", model_code, model_cppname) : 
  "CPP_stanc260" not resolved from current namespace (rstan)


After reading the FAQ I set debug mode to on and reran and got this error:

> set_cppo(mode = "debug")
mode debug with DDEBUG for compiling C++ code is set
> rats_fit <- stan(file = 'rats.stan', data = rats_dat, verbose = TRUE)

TRANSLATING MODEL 'rats' FROM Stan CODE TO C++ CODE NOW.
Error in .Call("CPP_stanc260", model_code, model_cppname) : 
  "CPP_stanc260" not resolved from current namespace (rstan)

What am I doing wrong?


Kevin

R version 3.1.3 (2015-03-09)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin13.4.0 (64-bit)
Running under: OS X 10.9.5 (Mavericks)

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: problems with 'rat's example: namespace issues
parts:
Possibly you just need to restart R. Make sure it does not load a .RData file that has objects created by a previous version of rstan.

Ben
